research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Deepgram is researching end to end automatic speech recognition with transformer architectures that fuse a first ASR model with transformer layers to improve recognition. It is also developing hardware efficient automatic speech recognition that dynamically configures compute resources for multiple AI models, and multistage alignment for generating artificial intelligence training data. Deep learning internal state index based search and classification supports efficient retrieval. These efforts span ASR modeling, infrastructure optimization, data preparation, and model search.

overview_description.description: Deepgram provides a voice artificial intelligence platform that offers developer-accessible APIs for converting speech to text, generating natural spoken responses from text, and building voice-enabled applications. The company’s products include speech-to-text models that handle both real-time and recorded audio with conversational understanding and text-to-speech services that produce human-like voice outputs for applications and agents. Its platform supports integration through unified APIs that allow processing of multilingual audio, language understanding features, and voice agent workflows for digital systems. Deepgram serves software developers and technology teams seeking to embed automated voice capabilities into their products and services using scalable AI models.
